intro:
One Chinese electric SUV jumped 620% in a single month. An EV is outselling the Toyota RAV4 for the year. And Toyota's most famous ute just roared back to number one. These are the 10 cars Australians went crazy for in 2026 – with the real sales numbers, the growth, and why each one is winning.

Figures are official VFACTS data (via CarExpert, CarsGuide, GoAuto and ACM); Tesla figures come from the Electric Vehicle Council.
